content.summary: Qualitative methodology audit and demographic breakdown of voter sentiment on the Alberta Equalization Referendum.
key_findings: Senior voters (65+) backed Yes at 58%, while voters 18-24 showed lowest Yes at 20%.
A 13-point gender gap showed 51% of men voting Yes vs 38% of women voting Yes.
Rural regions recorded 48% Yes and Central Alberta reached 57% Yes.
Yes voters rated issue importance at 8.1/10 while No voters rated importance at 4.0/10, yielding a 4.1-point turnout salience gap.
The survey had a verified sample size of N=1,204 with a 2.8% margin of error.
Online panel collection mode may introduce opt-in participation skew requiring weight adjustments.
